blocks.text: LOS Angeles, United States — Soulful British singer-songwriter Raye on Monday topped the Grammy nominations with 11 and Spanish superstar Rosalia earned nine in a strong showing for female artists across the board. Women have historically been underrepresented at the Grammy Awards held by the Recording Academy, whose 69th annual gala will take place on February 7 in Los Angeles. But recent years have seen women dominate both the industry and the trophies list.
